prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / educational word-card illustration. Create ONE production-ready illustration for a vocabulary card, in the exact same illustrated world as the supplied approved keepsake reference. Treat the reference as STYLE guidance, not a layout to reproduce. MATCH its warm dark-brown organic hand-drawn contour, soft opaque gouache fill, subtle paper texture within painted areas, rounded children's-book shapes, coherent warm daylight and carefully drawn material details. Not a flat geometric pictogram, not a symbol icon, not clipart, not 3D, not photorealistic. Small-square composition; subject occupies 82–88% of a square canvas with safe padding; readable as an illustration at 64–96 CSS px. A complete scene/object vignette with genuine transparent background around it. Do not draw a white card, frame, fake transparency checkerboard, badge, medal, stars or text unless the subject specification explicitly requests it. No extra characters, watermarks or lettering. Use the forest greens, cream, honey brown and muted blue of the reference. Keep the reference's storybook finish and detail, not only its palette.
Subject specification: Vocabulary: surround, 包围／环绕. A small warm cream cottage visibly surrounded on ALL SIDES by a loose circular cluster of five leafy trees, including trees in front and behind the cottage. Slightly elevated three-quarter view makes the all-around relationship unmistakable. Hand-painted leafy crowns with warm brown outlined trunks and a small coherent ground patch; cottage clear at center. No people. Do not use flat arrows or diagram symbols.

Subject specification: Vocabulary: wood, 树林（本课用法）. A richly illustrated small woodland grove with five distinct rounded leafy trees, layered canopies, warm trunks, undergrowth, little rocks and a soft earth path. Clearly a natural grove, NOT lumber or a stack of wood. Match the foliage and tree painting of the approved forest keepsake. No people, sign or litter. A compact forest vignette; transparent beyond its natural edges.

Subject specification: Vocabulary: hundred, 百. One small freestanding wooden teaching sign with rounded corners and warm brown hand-drawn contours and softly painted wood grain matching the notice board in the reference. The face is pale cream for strong contrast, displaying ONLY the exact three large digits "100" in dark warm brown. All three digits must be accurate and clear at thumbnail size. Slight three-quarter thickness, no ornate frame, no badge, medal, stars, extra numbers or extra text. A little grass at its feet, complete edges and transparent surroundings.

Subject specification: Vocabulary: city, 城市. An inviting compact city vignette with five closely grouped multi-storey buildings, clearly urban rather than a tiny rural village: warm cream and terracotta facades, a couple of taller buildings in the back, teal windows, and a short continuous street in front. Coherent three-quarter perspective, rounded children's-book building shapes, hand-painted roofs and windows, warm brown linework and soft material shading matching the supplied reference. No readable signs, people, logos, cars or text.

Subject specification: Vocabulary: through, 穿过. Show the same older bespectacled narrator as in the approved reference, with beige flat cap, olive jacket, red scarf, brown trousers and brown shoulder satchel, walking ALONG a clear path THROUGH an opening between two foreground trees into a small woodland. Keep his recognizable identity and friendly storybook proportions. Use a side/three-quarter view so his walking pose and the path continuing beyond the trees are both clear. One person only, full body intact, natural feet on the path, no arrows, no sign, no lettering. Compact vignette, transparent surrounding area.
